Problem Statement
Read an integer and determine whether it is positive, negative, or zero using an if-else-if ladder.
Description
Read an integer num from input. Use an if-else-if ladder to check three possibilities: whether num is greater than 0, less than 0, or equal to 0, and print "Positive", "Negative", or "Zero" accordingly.
Input Description
A single integer num.
Output Description
Print "Positive" if num is greater than 0, "Negative" if num is less than 0, or "Zero" if num equals 0.
Sample Input
-5
Sample Output
Negative
